name: session-chronicle
description: Sidebar that analyzes how you use Claude Code: live warnings, cost, tips, standup and CLAUDE.md improvements. English and Japanese.

language.title: Language
language.description: Pane language. auto follows Claude Code's language setting.

aiModel.title: AI model
aiModel.description: Model for the 詳しく explanation and AI summary. haiku is cheapest; fable consumes usage credits and only runs when you press g.

aiEffort.title: AI effort
aiEffort.description: Thinking effort for those calls. low keeps tokens down.

autoExplain.title: Explain on open
autoExplain.description: Generate the AI explanation as soon as 詳しく opens. Off: press g to generate. Cached answers are always shown.

cacheExplanations.title: Cache explanations
cacheExplanations.description: Keep explanations of Cost/Tips/Improve findings in the plugin store (plain JSON, 40 entries, 14 days) so reopening costs no tokens.

reviewerAgents.title: Review agents
reviewerAgents.description: Comma-separated subagent names that count as code review (e.g. code-reviewer,security-reviewer). Claude Code ships none, so the review checks stay off until you name yours.

memoryTools.title: Note-search tools
memoryTools.description: Comma-separated MCP tool name prefixes or CLI names you use to search your notes (e.g. mcp__notes__,notes). Empty turns the recall check off.

memoryCueWords.title: Earlier-context words
memoryCueWords.description: Comma-separated words that mean a prompt needs earlier context. Empty uses built-in English and Japanese words.

extraRiskyCommands.title: Extra risky commands
extraRiskyCommands.description: Comma-separated command substrings to flag besides rm -r, force push, reset --hard, ssh/scp/rsync and sudo (e.g. terraform apply).

retentionDays.title: Keep summaries (days)
retentionDays.description: How long session summaries are kept. 0 follows Claude Code's cleanupPeriodDays (30 by default).

excludeProjects.title: Excluded projects
excludeProjects.description: Comma-separated project path prefixes to leave out of the analysis (e.g. customer work)
